notes:
Account summary: large US defense contractor subsidiary running contact centers for critical infrastructure operators. They require a fully on-prem, air-gapped agent-assist solution that can integrate with existing Genesys/Avaya/Salesforce stacks and ServiceNow for automated ticket actions. Primary drivers: security posture (no egress), deterministic latency during emergency surge, and operational control over model updates.

Shorthand from calls: "can't have outbound model calls to public cloud; updates only via signed artifacts". CISO explicitly requested DoD IL-level controls and STIG alignment. Procurement: heavy on lifecycle cost and patch/update windows.

Preferred models: quantized, vetted open models (customer will provide whitelist). Must support local tool-calling (case create/update, run playback, agent whisper) without external callbacks.

Quote from engineering lead: "We need 99.9% availability during shift change spikes and full traceability of token-level decisions for investigations. Latency budget: 50-150ms per assistant turn for whisper/agent assist workflows."

technical_requirements: Must deploy inside customer air-gapped datacenter. No outbound internet egress allowed from inference nodes. Model artifacts must be delivered as signed images (SHA + PKI) and installed via offline channel. Integration: Genesys contact flow hooks, Avaya SIP gateway, Salesforce case links, ServiceNow API over private network. Security: DISA STIG alignment desired, FISMA/DoD IL4-IL5 controls, HSM-backed key management (customer KMS), audit logs retained 7 years, token-level tracing for every assistant response. Reliability: support continuous batching but able to enforce strict 50-150ms p95 for agent-assist under normal load; guaranteed fallback model variants for degraded hardware and predictable throttling during incident spikes. Offline evals: must include quality regressions tests tied to baseline prompt set and automated rollback triggers.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): architecture confirmation + STIG questionnaire completion. Phase 2 (3 weeks): air-gapped private deployment in customer's staging DC; integrate with Genesys sandbox and ServiceNow staging. Phase 3 (1 week): blackbox load tests simulating shift-change spikes (target 3x baseline for 15min windows). Phase 4 (2 weeks): security penetration test + red-team. Acceptance criteria: successful per-turn latency SLOs, signed model update workflow validated, tool-calling actions executed end-to-end, and security checklist signed by customer CISO. Next commercial step: finalize SOW and procurement path after POC signoff.
